VI.description: Creates or overwrites the Win32 wrapper VIs of the RemoteVI toolkit in source\5CWin32 by VI scripting - one VI per DLL function\2C each listed in the wrapper specs constant on this diagram (wrapper name\2C template\2C DLL\2C function\2C parameter lines\2C link lines - see W32B Parse Spec.vi for the line format). Each wrapper starts as a copy of its template in scripts\5CWin32 Wrapper Templates (front panel\2C connector pane\2C icon\2C descriptions\2C helper nodes)\2C then gets a Call Library Function Node placed\2C configured (stdcall\2C run in any thread\2C typed parameters) and wired by VI Server - the one node AIXML cannot author. only these wrappers limits the run to the named wrapper VIs (empty = all)\3B a wrapper that is loaded in LabVIEW (called by a running VI) cannot be overwritten. Run it from the IDE whenever a template or a spec changes. Paths are found relative to this VI\2C so the repository may live anywhere. The AIXML sources of the templates are in tools\5Caixml\5CWin32.

Control.description: Wrapper VI names to build\2C e.g. user32 GetDC.vi. Empty builds every wrapper in the spec list.
Nothing is built when this carries an error.

Indicator.description: Path of every wrapper built\2C in spec order\3B an empty path for a spec that was skipped.
error in or the first error of any build. The builds after a failed one are skipped.
